correctness.rationale: For A=KQ_n/J², nilpotent arrows map into J since A/J=K^n is reduced; quotient unital algebra map gives arbitrary vertex function phi. Orthogonal idempotent lifts in square-zero J uniquely parameterized by s_j on changed-color edges through conjugation (1+s)E_i(1-s). Peirce support forces F(a_i) to sum beta_j a_j for phi(j)=i and phi(j+1)=i+1; these choices satisfy every multiplication relation. On J the arrow source groups have disjoint supports and binary nonzero rank contributions, yielding the full polynomial q^d T^|im phi| prod_i[1+(q^m_i-1)T]. Transfer matrix with diagonal 1, successor q², other q has eigenvalues L=q²+(n-2)q+1 and (q-1)(q zeta-1); roots-of-unity filter gives stated total. Automorphisms require cycle rotations with nonzero arrows: n q^n(q-1)^n, and fixed-n density 1-n/q+O(q^-2). Independently enumerated phi and counts for (n,q)=(2,2),(2,3),(3,2),(3,3),(4,2), reproducing E=34,164,363,2757,6628, and n3 q2 rank coefficients (3,72,120,72,72,24).
